notes.title: SUPER CELEBRATION SOFTWAVES
notes.content:
Hello guys.

We come through this announcement to bring great news to all of you ːsteammockingː!


THE SPECIALTY OF THE EVENT
You must be wondering why we do this event, and the answer is simple: we are celebrating 6 years of Softwaves in the market ːsteamhappyː.

Well, time goes by so fast, right? 6 years have passed since our first release (I remember it like it was yesterday).

We couldn't let such a special date go unnoticed, and that's why we're doing this super commemorative event, entitled SUPER CELEBRATION SOFTWAVES.


ABOUT THE EVENT
PART 1 - Tasks
From February 11 to February 25, 2023 some of our titles will have some "tasks" to be done by players that will generate rewards. See below the tasks ːsteamsaltyː and their respective rewards ːsteamthumbsupː.


 Freight Simulator
ːsteamsaltyː Task: Reach the balance of F$1,000,00 in the business account.
ːsteamthumbsupː Reward: 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for the game Duty in the Forest OR 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for the game Island Domination.

 Mission Z
ːsteamsaltyː Task: Finish the mission "The grand finale".
ːsteamthumbsupː Reward: 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Duty in the Forest OR 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Island Domination OR 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Transporter Manager Tycoon - Mods on the DLC Road.

 Transporter Manager Tycoon
ːsteamsaltyː Task: Acquire a Warehouse in the game.
ːsteamthumbsupː Reward: 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Duty in the Forest OR 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Island Domination OR 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Mission Z: Climates DLC.

To get your prize, just send an image proving that you have completed the objective in our community tab on Steam, or by Discord, or by email.

PART 2 - Questions and suggestions
In all our games, a topic entitled "Questions and Suggestions" was opened, in the "Community Hub" tab, where we will open spaces for users to ask a question related to the game or Softwaves, or even send suggestions for improvement for the game.

The selected questions/suggestions will be answered by the team and we will award the selected ones ːsteamhappyː, the awards could be, alternatively:


 01 (one) Steam activation key for the game Duty in the Forest.
 01 (one) Steam activation key for the Island Domination game.
 01 (one) Steam activation key for the Mission Z: Climates DLC.
 01 (one) Steam activation key for the Transporter Manager Tycoon DLC - Mods on the Road.

Questions/suggestions will be selected and answered after the event ends on February 26, 2023

THE GOOD NEWS
For 14 days (starting February 11, 2023) ALL of our titles will be at incredible discounts, historic prices, never seen before.

This way, you can buy that game you have on your wishlist (the one you've been waiting for the perfect moment, a super discount), or take the opportunity to get to know some of our other titles, for a very affordable price (we would be right to say unmissable, is not?)

ːsteamthisː Take advantage of unmissable discounts. ːsteamthisː


PROJECTIONS FOR THE FUTURE
We are working on new titles, soon we will announce them to you.

My boss forgive me, but I can't keep it a secret ːsteamfacepalmː, I'm going to give some spoilers about what's to come: We're working on a new mission game, where you'll have the freedom to choose which adventure you want to face, with customization of equipment and lots of awesome mechanics. 

Also, we're working on a new tycoon game, with tons of management options, and a surprising theme (you'll be blown away).

Soon we will update you about the new titles that are coming ːsteammockingː.


BUNDLES
I don't want to influence anyone to make good choices, but have you seen this? 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18987/New_Waves/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24304/All_in__Mission_Z/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24305/All_in__Transporter_Manager_Tycoon/

OUR TITLES ON PROMOTION
In addition, as stated earlier, all our titles are LOW, HISTORICAL PRICES. Take a look:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1208950/Freight_Simulator/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1401750/Mission_Z/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1513580/Transporter_Manager_Tycoon/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561020/Island_Domination/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561480/Duty_in_the_Forest/


ALL OUR GAMES
Here you can see all our games, and even leave that follow to give us a go:

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/softwaves


What did you think of this event ːsteamthumbsupː ːsteamthumbsdownː? Comment there so we can improve or even bring it back in the future.
